messages:
maya: Heads-up — need a concise one-pager that compares Security & SLA implications across Hosted / Dedicated / Private for the upcoming webinar. Target: field + AE enablement. Short, scannable, and a single slideable PDF.

julian: +1. Can we include recommended routing for inbound leads (which tier -> sales motion) and two benchmark callouts: latency on Hosted vs Dedicated, and data residency notes for Private?

sam: Yup. For routing I'd suggest: high-security/regulatory -> AE + Solutions, large-commit throughput -> Dedicated sales outreach, trial/PLG -> self-serve CS. We should add thresholds (qps, RPS, contract $) so SDRs know when to escalate.

ana: I'll draft the thresholds. Proposed quick thresholds: 
- >$50k ARR or >1000 RPS -> Enterprise AE 
- Sensitive data + legal reqs (HIPAA/GDPR) -> Solutions/Compliance lead 
- Otherwise -> PLG/SDR nurture
Can we make those bullets visible on the one-pager?

lee: For SLA framing, we need to be explicit about available SLOs by deployment: 
- Hosted: best-effort, 99.5% regional uptime, standard support
- Dedicated: 99.95% SLA, reserved GPUs, support SLA options
- Private: 99.99% contractual SLA + on-prem options
Also add note about fallback routing to compatible model variants if capacity constrained.

maya: Good. Add a tiny benchmark nugget: average 95th p99 latency numbers we published for the last report (we'll not expose raw logs). Julian, can you confirm exact p99 figures?

julian: From the infra doc: p99 gen latency (8k token window) — Hosted ~420ms, Dedicated tuned ~260ms, Private variable (depends infra) but expect ~300-600ms. I'll link the bench notes. https://docs.internal/redwood/benchmarks/infra-latency-2025

sam: For sales copy, combine: "Predictable performance at scale — choose Hosted for fast uptake, Dedicated for committed throughput, Private for regulated controls." Keep it tight.

ana: Webinar angle: 10-min demo + 10-min benchmark story + 10-min Q&A. One-pager handed out as post-webinar asset + field playbook. Also want a single checklist for customers to self-assess deployment needs.

maya: OK actions: 
- @ana: draft routing thresholds + checklist (due EOD Wed)
- @julian: confirm bench numbers and write 2-line explainer for each deploy mode (due tomorrow)
- @sam: write the 1-line sales blurb + one recommended routing matrix for SDR use (due Thu)
- @lee: put the SLA bullets and quick note about fallback routing into the doc (due Thu)
- @maya: I'll assemble into one-pager and export PDF + google slide.

deploy-bot: Scheduled export completed: https://drive.redwood/team/marketing/enterprise-onepager-drafts/1998765432-draft-v1.pdf

julian: uploaded a short table for latency numbers in the drive doc — added a small note about variance by seq length.

sam: quick routing snippet for SDRs (copyable):
```
if lead.compliance == true or lead.regulated == true:
  route -> solutions@redwood
elif lead.commitment_estimated >= 50000 or lead.rps >= 1000:
  route -> enterprise-ae
else:
  route -> plg-nurture
```

lee: Thx. @maya can we add a one-line legal caveat: "Actual SLA and security posture subject to contract and deployment configuration" — legal wants it.

maya: Yep. I'll add that. Final ask: keep one-pager to one side of A4, two columns: left = decision checklist + routing; right = deploy mode quick facts + benchmarks + CTA (book demo / contact sales).

ana: I'll drop the first draft into the shared doc by EOD. Link once done.

maya: Awesome — we'll review Fri 9am PT. If anyone can't make it, drop comments in the doc. :thumbsup:
